title: Peacock Patterns and Resurgence in Complex Chern–Simons Theory
note: arXiv:2012.00062, Res. Math. Sci. 10 (2023) Paper No. 29. Added 2026-07-17 from library/arxiv-2012.00062v3/2012.00062v3.pdf. Companion to garoufalidis-gu-marino2021: the state-integral partition function $Z_M(u;\tau)$, its $q$-holonomic module and descendants $W_m(x;q)$ (holomorphic for $|q|\neq 1$), and the Stokes matrices for real $u$ (§5.6). Key structural fact for the 1ppq $A_\omega$ target: the Stokes constants are integers equal to the Donaldson–Thomas invariants of the associated $q$-difference structure (eq. 16(d)) — a derived integer count, not a fit.
